result.title: M$^3$-Test: Coverage Gaps in Joint-Perturbation Testing of Visual Question Answering
result.summary: A visual question answering (VQA) model can pass every image-only and question-only test yet fail when the same changes occur together. Standard robustness reports average over conditions and therefore cannot say which accepted requests remain vulnerable. We introduce M3-Test, a coverage audit that aligns each clean input with its single-modality variants and a complete 5x5 family, 4x4 strength joint library, so that any reduced test suite can be replayed on the same requests. Across 2.6 million responses from four vision-language models, joint failures affect 26-29% of the Qwen questions that pass all 40 single-modality tests, although fewer than 0.6% of their joint records fail. Passing the 25 maximum-strength corners does not close this gap: 11-14% of the accepted questions still fail elsewhere in the library. Re-executing the archived failures reproduces about 90% of them, against a 0.3-0.6% flip rate among matched passing controls, and re-checking the most fragile failure records supports 80-89% of them. On the evidence examined, neither execution noise nor grading error can fully account for the gap. The same aligned grids make previous evaluations reusable. On held-out images, a risk order learned from other models discovers about 80% of affected Qwen questions within 25 additional queries, compared with 65-68% for maximum-first and 53-57% for pairwise covering arrays. M3-Test thus turns a passing robustness suite into a request-level account of what remains untested, supporting acceptance, regression review and test allocation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 M3-Test，将每个干净输入与其单模态变体以及 5×5、4×4 强度联合扰动库对齐，构成可重放的覆盖审计，在四个 VLM 的约 260 万条回答上刻画「通过全部单模态测试、却在联合扰动下失败」的请求比例与分布。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「对齐扰动网格＋请求级风险排序分配查询」可能可供核查 LVR 在视觉与问题条件同时变化时 latent 状态是否真正使用视觉证据，以及如何在有限验证查询下优先暴露失败；但论文不涉及内部表示或推理状态生成，仅为评价方法线索。
